CN:
【受到某些力量的侵蚀，笔记本上的许多内容已经模糊不清。根据残存的内容，你推断这是一个名叫洛塔的罗伊族女孩留下的日记。】
……
今天爸爸带我去找了那位引日者姐姐，她说了一些很难听懂的话，好像是我有什么特殊的共鸣能力，所以那些隧群才一见到我就跑。回家的路上爸爸一直在叹气，我从没见过他这么忧心忡忡的样子。
我大概知道他为什么这么问。上次我想要和他放牧的隧群一起玩的时候，它们突然惊慌失措地乱跑，还顶伤了妈妈。
这是洛塔的错吗……我问爸爸，但他只是叹了口气，用宽大又温暖的手掌揉了揉我的头。
“不要紧，孩子。”他就像平常一样，用轻松的语气逗着我，“哪怕当不了牧者，你也是个好孩子。”
……
今天爸爸回来的时候没带着隧群，他说他把隧群都拜托给其他的牧者叔叔了，我知道他是担心它们再弄伤妈妈。
这都是洛塔的错。如果不是我，爸爸就不会丢掉工作了。他会像那些帅气的牧者一样，赶着隧群去冰原之上，虔诚地觐见给了我们阳光和一切的巴德尔。
……
爸爸今天很高兴，可能是因为妈妈的伤快好了吧。他带我来到一个很远很远的村子里，那里住着一个老奶奶，他要我留下来，和她学习石雕。老奶奶说，她也有着和我差不多的力量，会激怒隧群，所以才搬到这里一个人住的。爸爸说石雕可好玩了，还说他有空就会和妈妈一起来看我。
……
石雕确实很好玩，老奶奶把她所会的一切都教给了我，还说我很有天分。这还是第一次有人这么说呢！爸爸和妈妈有点忙，他们已经有十多天没来过了，不过我交上了新的朋友——喜欢跳舞的旅鼠芬尼尔，爱吃鱼的雪衫帝达拉斯，还有总是到处啃花的鼹雀布里。
我在一块石板上刻下了我们的样子，按照老奶奶的说法，这样我们就是永远的好朋友了。
……
爸爸和妈妈还是没来。我拜托芬尼尔、达拉斯和布里去村里找他们，我想他们了。
但我等啊，等啊，爸爸妈妈，还有我的朋友们……它们再也没出现过。
过了几天，村里的威尔森叔叔来找老奶奶，他看起来不再是那个威风凛凛的牧者了，怎么看都狼狈不堪。他们谈了很长时间，我躲在屋外，偷偷听到他提到了我爸爸的名字，村子，还有叫“虚质磁暴”和“残象”的东西。
那个东西听起来就很让人不安……也许我该悄悄回村子看看，只要我不接近隧群，应该就不会有问题。
EN:
[Large sections of the notebook are illegible, corroded by some unknown force. From the remaining fragments, you deduce it's the diary of a Roya girl named Lotta.]
...
Today, Papa took me to see the Solsworn lady. She said a lot of things I couldn't really understand... something about my Forte being special. So that's why the Exoswarm flee the second they see me. On the way home, Papa wouldn't stop sighing. I've never seen him look so worried before.
I think I know why. Last time, when I tried to play with the Exoswarm he was herding, they just... snapped. They panicked and ran wild. They even hurt Mama.
"Was that my fault?" I asked him. He just sighed, then reached out and rubbed my head with his big, warm hand.
"Do not fret, little one," he said, his voice light like always. "If you are not meant to be a Shepherdess, you are still a good girl."
...
Papa came home with nothing today. He said he gave the Exoswarm to the other Shepherds. I know he is afraid they will hurt Mama again.
This is all my fault. If I weren't like this, Papa wouldn't have lost his job. He'd still be out there, like one of those proud Shepherds guiding the Exoswarm across the frostlands, paying tribute to Baldur for the sunlight and everything we have.
...
Papa seemed happy today. I think it's because Mama is almost healed. He took me to a village far, far away. There's an old granny living there, and he asked me to stay with her to learn stone carving. The granny told me she has a power just like mine, something that makes the Exoswarm angry, so she moved out here to be alone. Papa promised me that carving is a lot of fun, and that he and Mama would come visit me as often as they could.
...
He was right. Stone carving is fun. The granny has taught me everything she knows. She even told me I have a "natural gift." That's the first time anyone has ever said that to me! Mama and Papa must be really busy, though. They haven't visited in over ten days. But it's okay, because I've made some new friends: Fenrir, a Toskr Lemming who can't stop dancing; Dallas, a Fluffguin who loves eating fish, and Bori, a Kronapuff who loves to nibble on flowers.
I carved all of us together onto a big stone slab. Granny says that means we'll be friends forever and ever.
...
Mama and Papa still haven't come. I asked Fenrir, Dallas, and Bori to go to the village and look for them. I miss them so much.
But I waited and waited... and nobody came back. Not Mama, not Papa... not my fluffy friends.
A few days later, Uncle Vilhelm from the village came to talk to Granny. He didn't look like the proud, strong Shepherd I remembered. He looked exhausted. They talked for a long time while I hid outside. I caught Papa's name, something about our village, and things like "Void Storms" and "Tacet Discords."
Just hearing those names makes my stomach do flips... I think I should sneak back to the village and see for myself. As long as I stay away from the Exoswarm, it should be fine.

【ある力の侵食を受け、ノートの大半はすでにぼやけて読めない。残された内容から、これはロッタという名のロイ一族の少女が残した日記だと推測した。】
……
今日、お父さんが私をあの<ano=太陽に契りし者>ソル・スウォーン</ano>のお姉さんのところへ連れて行ってくれた。お姉さんは難しい言葉をいくつか口にしていたけど、どうやら私は特別な共鳴能力を持っていて、エクソスウォームたちは私を見るとすぐに逃げ出してしまうらしい。帰り道、お父さんはずっとため息をついていた。あんなに心配そうな顔を見たのは初めてだった。
どうしてそんなことを聞いてきたのか、だいたいわかってる。この前、お父さんが放牧しているエクソスウォームと遊ぼうとしたら、彼らが突然パニックになって走り回り、お母さんにぶつかって怪我をさせてしまったから。
これはロッタのせいなのかな……。お父さんに聞くと、大きくて温かい手で私の頭を撫でてくれた。
「気にしなくていいよ、ロッタ」お父さんはいつものように、ゆったりとした口調でそう言った。「たとえ牧者になれなくても、お前はいい子だよ」
……
今日、お父さんが帰ってきたとき、エクソスウォームを連れていなかった。全部、他の牧者のおじさんたちに預けたんだって。お母さんがまた怪我をしないように、気を遣っているんだと思う。
全部ロッタのせいだ。私がいなければ、お父さんは仕事を失わなかったのに。あのかっこいい牧者たちみたいに、エクソスウォームを追って氷原へ向かい、私たちに陽の光とすべてを与えてくれた<ano=エクソストライダー>バルドル</ano>に、敬虔に謁見できたはずなのに。
……
お父さんは今日、とても嬉しそうだ。お母さんの怪我がもうすぐ治るからかな。お父さんはとても遠い村へ私を連れて行った。そこには一人のおばあさんが住んでいて、私にここに残り、石彫りを学ぶよう言った。おばあさんも私と同じ力を持っていて、エクソスウォームを怒らせてしまうから、一人でここに移り住んできたんだって。お父さんは「石彫りはとても面白いよ」と言い、時間があるときにはお母さんと一緒に会いに来ると約束してくれた。
……
石彫りは本当に面白い。おばあさんは知っていることをすべて教えてくれて、私には才能があるって言ってくれた。こんなふうに言われたのは初めて！お父さんとお母さんは少し忙しいみたいで、もう十日以上も来ていない。でも、新しい友達ができた――ダンスが好きなレミングのフェンリル、魚が大好きなフラッフペンギンのダラス、いつもあちこちで花をかじっているポヨポヨエナガのブリーだ。
一枚の石板に、私たちの姿を刻んだ。おばあさんの言う通りにすれば、これで私たちは永遠の親友になれる。
……
お父さんとお母さんは、まだ来ない。フェンリル、ダラス、ブリーに、村へ行って探してきてもらうようお願いした。二人に会いたいな。
でも、いくら待っても――お父さんもお母さんも、私の友達たちも……誰も戻ってこなかった。
数日後、村のウィルソンおじさんがおばあさんのところを訪ねてきた。あの威風堂々とした牧者の面影はなく、見るからにぼろぼろだった。二人は長いあいだ話し込んでいて、私は家の外に隠れてその様子を聞いていた。彼の口から、お父さんの名前と村の名前、それに「ヴォイドストーム」と「残像」という言葉が聞こえてきた。
聞いているだけで不安になった……こっそり村へ戻って確かめるべきかもしれない。エクソスウォームに近づかなければ、きっと大丈夫なはずだから。

Họ nói chuyện rất lâu, mình trốn ngoài nhà, lén nghe được chú ấy nhắc đến tên ba mình, ngôi làng, và những thứ gọi là "Bão từ Voidmatter" và "Tàn Tượng".

【受到某些力量的侵蚀，笔记本上的许多内容已经模糊不清。根据残存的内容，你推断这是一个名叫洛塔的罗伊族女生留下的日记。】
……
……
没了，什么都没了。
我在原本应该是村子的地方找了半天，只找到了一小块烧焦的皮毛，一撮羽毛……还有半个鸟喙。爸爸，妈妈……村子里的大家……还有我的朋友们，都没了。
有什么东西在盯着我，我不想逃跑了。
……
我花了好长时间，才重新学会说话。才有勇气……重新翻开这本日记。
从那些怪物手中救下我的人自称是“星炬学院”的教授，她是个漂亮的女性，但看起来和村里的人们不太一样。她说我有某种很特殊的共鸣能力，能够成为适格者。
我跟她说了村子里发生的一切，我问她，这到底是<ano=隧者>巴德尔</ano>赐予我的恩赐，还是<ano=鸣式>赫龙格</ano>最为恶毒的诅咒？她沉默了片刻，告诉我，她的故乡也在类似的灾难中毁灭了。而她跨过我无法想象的广阔海洋来到此地，就是为了找到让这个世界上的每个人都能摆脱这种命运的方法。而她希望我加入星炬学院，不管我所背负的到底是祝福还是诅咒，都有可能成为打开那扇门的钥匙。
……但我已经一无所有了。即使那扇门背后就是<ano=隧者>巴德尔</ano>，祂想必也无法赐予我那些我已然失去的东西。
……
我回了一趟老奶奶那里，向她告别，以及感谢她这些日子对我的照顾。我告诉她，我打算加入星炬学院了。

和教授说的一样，只有我，只有我的共鸣能力才能拯救那座即将消失的村子。我过去没能拯救我的故乡，而此刻，我绝不会再眼看着它吞没我所爱的人们。

[Large sections of the notebook are illegible, corroded by some unknown force. From the remaining fragments, you deduce it's the diary of a Roya girl named Lotta.]
...
...
It's all gone. Everything.
I searched for so long for where the village used to be. All I found was a small patch of scorched fur, a tuft of feathers... and half a beak. Papa. Mama... everyone in the village... my friends... they're all gone.
Something is watching me. I don't want to run anymore.
...
It took me a long, long time to learn how to speak again. Even longer to find the courage to open this diary.
The woman who saved me from those monsters called herself a professor from Startorch Academy. She's beautiful, but she doesn't look like anyone from our village. She told me I have a rare kind of Forte, something that makes me a "potential Synchronist."
I told her everything that happened to the village. I asked her: is this a blessing from <ano=the Exostrider>Baldur</ano>? Or the cruelest curse <ano=the Threnodian>Hvedrungr</ano> ever devised?
She was silent for a while. Then, she told me her own homeland had been swallowed by a similar disaster. She crossed an ocean so vast I can't even imagine it, all to find a way to free the world from this fate. She asked me to join the Academy. She said that whether my power is a blessing or a curse, it might be the key to opening the door to our future.
...But I have nothing left. Even if <ano=the Exostrider>Baldur</ano> is waiting behind that door, it can't give back what I've already lost.
...
I went back to Granny's place to say goodbye and thank her for everything. I told her I was leaving for the Academy.
"We Roya carve our words into stone," she said, her voice as kind as ever, "so that <ano=the Threnodian>Hvedrungr</ano> cannot erase our existence. And those children at the Academy use something they call 'Cassettes' to do the same. To me, you're just going somewhere else... to carve the statue that belongs to you."
"As long as the memory remains, so does the soul."
After I arrived at the Academy, I read this notebook from the very first page to the last. Papa, Mama, Fenrir, Dallas, Bori... Granny was right. They're still alive here in these pages, and deep within my mind. Maybe, without even realizing it, I've become a living statue carved with all their names.
I'll carry their souls with me, wherever I go. I promise.
...
Void Storms. Even the name is terrifying.
I've spent my life trying to outrun its shadow. It's one of <ano=the Threnodian>Hvedrungr's</ano> venomous tendrils, dragging everything I love into the nothingness. I thought... I thought I had learned how to ignore it.
But seeing it appear again, I realized something. All these years of study... they were just preparation for this exact moment. Again and again, I've pushed my Forte to its limit, right to the edge of Overclocking. And now, I finally understand. I'm ready.
Just like the professor said, only I, only my Forte, can save that village from being wiped out. I couldn't save my own home back then. But this time, I won't stand by and watch the dark take the people I love.
It's time to go.
JP:
【ある力の侵食を受け、ノートの多くの内容はすでにぼやけて読めない。残された内容から、あなたはこれがロッタという名のロイ一族の少女が残した日記だと推測した。】
……
……
消えてしまった。何もかも消えてしまった。
元々村だったはずの場所をずっと探したけど、見つかったのは焦げた毛皮の切れ端と、一握りの羽……それに鳥のくちばしが半分だけ。お父さん、お母さん……村のみんな……私の友達も、みんないなくなった。
何かが私を見つめてる。もう逃げたくない。
……
また喋れるようになるまで、とても時間がかかった。勇気を振り絞って、この日記をもう一度開くまで。
あの怪物たちから私を救ってくれた人は「スタートーチ学園」の教授だと名乗った。綺麗な女の人だったけど、村の人たちとは少し違う雰囲気だった。私には特殊な共鳴能力があって、適格者になれると彼女は言った。
村で起こったことをすべて話し、問いかけた。これは<ano=エクソストライダー>バルドル</ano>が私に与えた恩恵なのか、それとも<ano=鳴式>フヴェズルング</ano>の最も悪毒な呪いなのか、と。彼女は少し黙ってから、自分の故郷も似たような災厄で滅んだと話してくれた。そして私が想像もつかないほど広い海を越えてここへ来たのは、この世界のすべての人がそんな運命から抜け出す方法を見つけるためなのだ、と。彼女は私にスタートーチ学園に入ってほしいと言った。私が背負っているのが祝福であれ呪いであれ、それがあの扉を開く鍵になるかもしれないから、と。
……でも私にはもう何もない。たとえあの扉の向こうに<ano=エクソストライダー>バルドル</ano>がいたとしても、私がすでに失ってしまったものを返してはくれないだろう。
……
おばあさんのところへ戻り、別れの挨拶とお礼を言った。スタートーチ学園に入るつもりだと伝えると、おばあさんは優しく私を見た。
「私たちロイ人は文字を石に刻むの。そうすれば<ano=鳴式>フヴェズルング</ano>も私たちの存在を奪えないから」彼女は続けた。「あの子たちはカセットと呼ぶもので、同じことをしている。だからあなたはただ、別の場所へ行って、あなただけの石像を彫るだけなのよ」
「記憶がある限り、魂はそこにある」
学園に戻ってから、ノートをもう一度最初から読み直した。お父さん、お母さん、フェンリル、ダラス、ブリー……おばあさんの言う通り、彼らはまだ私の日記の中で、私の記憶の奥深くで生きている。もしかしたら知らないうちに……私はとっくに名前がたくさん刻まれた彫像になっていたのかもしれない。
彼らの魂と一緒に歩んでいく。約束する。
……
ヴォイドストーム。恐ろしい名前。
ずっとその影から抜け出そうとしてきた。それは<ano=鳴式>フヴェズルング</ano>の毒牙の生えた触腕で、かつて私の愛するすべてを虚無へと引きずり込んだ。もうその存在を気にしないふりができると思っていた。
でも再び現れたとき、気づいた。過去数年の学びは、すべて今日のための準備だったのだと。共鳴エナジーを何度も限界まで、オーバークロック寸前まで押し上げた。そして今、準備が整ったと悟った。
教授が言った通り、私だけが、私の共鳴能力だけが、あの消えゆく村を救うことができる。過去に故郷を救えなかった。でも今度は、愛する人々が飲み込まれるのを黙って見ているつもりは絶対にない。
出発の時間が来た。

Đến lúc phải lên đường rồi.

Mình đã kể cho cô ấy nghe mọi chuyện xảy ra trong làng, mình hỏi cô ấy, đây rốt cuộc là ân huệ do Baldur ban cho mình, hay là lời nguyền độc ác nhất của Minh Thức Hvedrungr? Cô ấy im lặng một lát, nói với mình, quê hương cô ấy cũng bị hủy diệt trong thảm họa tương tự. Và cô ấy vượt qua đại dương rộng lớn mà mình không thể tưởng tượng nổi đến đây, chính là để tìm ra cách giúp mỗi người trên thế giới này thoát khỏi số phận đó. Và cô ấy hy vọng mình gia nhập Học viện Startorch, bất kể thứ mình gánh vác rốt cuộc là phước lành hay lời nguyền, đều có khả năng trở thành chiếc chìa khóa mở ra cánh cửa đó.
…Nhưng mình đã không còn gì nữa. Cho dù sau cánh cửa đó là Baldur, Ngài ấy chắc hẳn cũng không thể ban cho mình những thứ mà mình đã mất.
…
Mình về chỗ bà lão một chuyến, nói lời tạm biệt với bà, cũng như cảm ơn bà vì đã chăm sóc mình những ngày qua. Mình nói với bà, mình định gia nhập Học viện Startorch.
"Người Roya chúng ta khắc chữ lên đá, như vậy Minh Thức Hvedrungr sẽ không thể cướp đi sự tồn tại của chúng ta." Bà hiền từ nhìn mình, "Và những đứa trẻ đó dùng thứ mà chúng gọi là băng cát-xét, làm chuyện tương tự. Cho nên, trong mắt ta, con chỉ là đi đến một nơi khác, điêu khắc bức tượng đá thuộc về con mà thôi."
"Chỉ cần ký ức vẫn còn, linh hồn sẽ ở đó."
Sau khi trở lại học viện, mình lại lật cuốn sổ tay của mình từ đầu đến cuối một lần nữa. Ba, mẹ, Fenrir, Dallas, Bori… Bà lão nói đúng, họ vẫn còn sống trong nhật ký của mình, sống sâu trong ký ức của mình. Có lẽ, không biết từ lúc nào… mình đã sớm là một bức tượng điêu khắc đầy những cái tên rồi.
Mình sẽ mang theo linh hồn của họ cùng bước tiếp, mình hứa.
…
Bão từ Hư Chất. Một cái tên đáng sợ.
Mình luôn cố gắng thoát khỏi ảnh hưởng của nó, nó chính là xúc tu đầy nanh độc của Minh Thức Hvedrungr, từng kéo mọi thứ mình yêu thương vào hư vô. Mình cứ tưởng mình đã có thể giả vờ không quan tâm đến sự tồn tại của nó.
Nhưng cho đến khi nó xuất hiện trở lại, mình mới chợt nhận ra, việc học tập trong vài năm qua của mình thực ra đều chỉ là chuẩn bị cho ngày hôm nay.
